The Ultimate Dhaba Style Punjabi Feast at Home!
Nothing beats the irresistible taste of dhaba food – rich gravies, bold spices and delicious hot parathas! This Sunday, bring those authentic Punjabi flavours to your home with three mouth-watering recipes.
Here's what's cooking:
Chole Dhania Masala – Tender chickpeas cooked in a flavourful coriander and green chilli masala, finished with a spicy red chilli tadka.
Paneer Bhurji with Paratha – Crumbled paneer tossed in a delicious onion-tomato masala, served with freshly prepared golden parathas.
